description: Client-side redline playbook for software/consulting agreements. All citations trace to the firm's clause library.

clauses.match_text: laws of the State of Delaware
clauses.replacement_text: laws of the State of New York
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause GL-001: Governing Law (New York)
clauses.rationale: Client is NY-based; NY law provides familiar precedent and favorable forum.

clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause PT-002: Payment Terms (Net 15)
clauses.rationale: Client prefers net-15 to improve cash flow; standard for consulting engagements.

clauses.match_text: Liability is unlimited for all claims.
clauses.replacement_text: Liability shall not exceed the fees paid by Client in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim, excluding gross negligence, willful misconduct, and IP infringement.
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause LC-003: Limitation of Liability (Capped with Carve-outs)
clauses.rationale: Cap liability at prior 12 months fees with standard carve-outs for gross negligence, willful misconduct, and IP infringement.

clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause TN-004: Termination Notice (30 Days Written)
clauses.rationale: Reduce notice period from 90 to 30 days for flexibility; require written notice for audit trail.

clauses.match_text: survive termination of this Agreement for five years
clauses.replacement_text: survive termination of this Agreement for three years
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause CS-005: Confidentiality Survival (3 Years)
clauses.rationale: Reduce confidentiality survival from 5 to 3 years to align with industry standard for software agreements.

clauses.match_text: Each party shall indemnify the other party from claims arising from that party's own breach, negligence, or willful misconduct.
clauses.replacement_text: Each party shall indemnify the other party from claims arising from that party's own breach, negligence, or willful misconduct.
clauses.citation: Firm Standard Clause IN-006: Mutual Indemnification
clauses.rationale: Add mutual indemnification clause — not present in original contract.
